summary: On the Main Deck, Tank registers something that has been altered—"Tank sees what was changed."—and, recognizing it, names the danger outright: "It's a trap!"

what_changes.before: not yet aware of the alteration
what_changes.after: recognizes the change as a deliberate trap
what_changes.evidence: Tank sees what was changed. It's a trap!

event_hint.one_line: Tank realises the Matrix has been altered and warns it is a trap.

uncertain: What exactly Tank sees that was changed.
Whether anyone else is on the Main Deck with Tank.
